description: Shell script for testing git command behaviors with invalid arguments and options, including setup, various command tests, and error handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands, and checks output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure, runs commands, and checks error output.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file.
